Cover

Make it by hand

  • Buy a black-paper spiral scrapbook (about A4 or 21×28 cm) and a pack of gel pens in pastel and metallic colours.
  • Print each photo about 8–10 cm wide. Glue it down first, then draw the dashed frames and wavy lines around it.
  • Copy the words from each page here, mixing three styles: joined-up cursive, tall skinny capitals, and fat bubble letters.
  • Fill the empty black space last with tiny dots, hearts, sparkles and flowers.
